description: Occurrence-layer coverage. Hard cases pin today's correct usage/site behaviour; expect_fail cases assert the target behaviour of the occurrence plan and flip to hard as each layer lands: complete default rendering for FIND usages, addressable directive rows (fql_kind 'guard'), role-typed occurrence rows (role = code|comment|string|config|doc) fed by the index-time mention/trigram layer, usage rows born addressable (file handle + file rev), substring occurrences for non-identifier strings, and Kconfig grammar rows. Ground truth captured live on the frozen corpora. NOTE: the comment role slice deliberately re-pinned the unfiltered-usages cases (usages_lines_exact_small_file 2 to 4 sites, usages_covers_if_defined_and_elif 4 to 11, usages_default_limit_files_complete total 98 to 112, usage_rows_born_addressable 2 to 4) because FIND usages now returns comment occurrences alongside code ones; the string role then moved that same total 112 to 116, the four BUILD_ASSERT message strings in drivers/input; the build-file argument role then moved 116 to 117, the lone zephyr_sources_ifdef argument naming that symbol in subsys/pm/CMakeLists.txt. the doc role then moved 117 to 127, and doc_role_accounts_for_the_whole_unfiltered_growth pins that the ten added sites are exactly the doc-role ones, so the growth is accounted for rather than absorbed. the config-value role for YAML, TOML and JSON then moved that total 127 to 140, and config_role_accounts_for_the_whole_unfiltered_growth pins the config-role sites at 14 — the one CMake argument plus thirteen config-file values — so that growth is accounted for rather than absorbed. Every added line was re-derived from the corpus, not adjusted to fit. Substring occurrences then landed: a C/C++ include path is recorded as one whole usage token, and a non-identifier OF is matched as a substring of the stored tokens as well as exactly, so substring_path_occurrences and substring_matches_a_fragment_of_the_path both hold. The remaining expect_fail cases are the two Kconfig ones, whose files have no grammar.

cases.name: usages_lines_exact_small_file
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME' IN 'subsys/pm/pm_shell.c'

cases.name: usages_covers_if_defined_and_elif
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME' IN 'include/zephyr/pm/device.h'

cases.name: import_rows_carry_include_path
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'import' WHERE name = 'zephyr/pm/device_runtime.h'

cases.name: path_segment_files_query
cases.fql: FIND files WHERE path MATCHES '(^|/)core(/|$)' IN 'arch/**'

cases.name: comment_nodes_name_searchable
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'comment' WHERE name LIKE '%CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME%' IN 'include/zephyr/pm/**' ORDER BY line ASC

steps.fql: CHANGE NODE '${F}(9-10)' IF REV '${R}' MATCHING 'kinds' WITH 'kindz'

cases.name: usages_default_limit_is_rendered_rows
cases.fql: FIND usages OF '__ASSERT_NO_MSG' IN 'drivers/i3c/i3c_ccc.c'

cases.name: usages_default_limit_files_complete
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME'

cases.name: if_defined_directives_have_symbol_rows
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'guard' WHERE name LIKE '%CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME%' IN 'include/zephyr/pm/device.h' ORDER BY line ASC

cases.name: ifdef_row_gains_kind_and_line
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'guard' WHERE name = 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME_ASYNC' IN 'include/zephyr/pm/device.h'

cases.name: ifdef_rows_all_gain_kind
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'guard' WHERE name = 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME' IN 'drivers/serial/uart_smartbond.c'

cases.name: role_comment_occurrences
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME' IN 'include/zephyr/pm/device.h' WHERE role = 'comment'

cases.name: role_config_cmake_flag
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME' IN 'subsys/pm/CMakeLists.txt' WHERE role = 'config'

cases.name: cmake_comment_is_not_a_config_occurrence
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'SPDX' IN 'subsys/pm/CMakeLists.txt' WHERE role = 'config'

cases.name: role_doc_rst_exact_token
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME' IN 'doc/services/pm/**' WHERE role = 'doc'

cases.name: doc_role_accounts_for_the_whole_unfiltered_growth
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME' WHERE role = 'doc'

cases.name: role_string_op_labels
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'find_usages' IN 'crates/forgeql-core/src/engine/exec_find.rs' WHERE role = 'string'

cases.name: role_code_retrofits_existing_sites
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME' IN 'include/zephyr/pm/device.h' WHERE role = 'code'

cases.name: usage_rows_born_addressable
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME' IN 'subsys/pm/pm_shell.c'

steps.fql: CHANGE NODES FOUND IF REV '${FR}' MATCHING 'dot_brace_min_len' WITH 'dot_brace_min_lenX'

cases.name: substring_path_occurrences
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'zephyr/pm/device_runtime.h' IN 'subsys/pm/**'

cases.name: substring_matches_a_fragment_of_the_path
cases.why: the discriminating case: 'pm/device_runtime.h' is not a stored token, so only a real substring pass over the token dictionary can reach the same five include sites
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'pm/device_runtime.h' IN 'subsys/pm/**'

cases.name: substring_matching_is_case_sensitive
cases.why: the trigram tier lowercases on insert and query, so it proposes this path as a candidate; the verify step is case-sensitive and must reject it
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'Zephyr/PM/Device_Runtime.h' IN 'subsys/pm/**'

cases.name: kconfig_definition_row
cases.expect_fail_reason: Kconfig files produce no symbol rows at all; the definition site of a flag is unaddressable
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE name = 'PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME' IN 'subsys/pm/Kconfig'

cases.name: kconfig_outline_config_entry
cases.expect_fail_reason: Kconfig has no grammar, so its outline is empty
cases.fql: SHOW outline OF 'subsys/pm/Kconfig' WHERE name = 'PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME'

cases.name: role_config_yaml_value
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'ubuntu-latest' IN '.github/workflows/ci.yml' WHERE role = 'config'

cases.name: yaml_key_is_not_a_config_occurrence
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'pull_request' IN '.github/workflows/ci.yml' WHERE role = 'config'

cases.name: role_config_toml_value
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'Viegas' WHERE role = 'config' WHERE file = 'Cargo.toml'

cases.name: toml_key_is_not_a_config_occurrence
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'authors' WHERE role = 'config'

cases.name: role_config_json_value
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'tree-sitter-yaml' IN 'crates/forgeql-lang-yaml/config/yaml.json' WHERE role = 'config'

cases.name: json_key_is_not_a_config_occurrence
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'block_mapping_pair' IN 'crates/forgeql-lang-yaml/config/yaml.json' WHERE role = 'config'

cases.name: config_role_accounts_for_the_whole_unfiltered_growth
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME' WHERE role = 'config'
